narr: Showers and thunderstorms repeatedly moved across Northern Madison and into Western Jackson Counties during the mid-morning hours, lingering into the afternoon hours on the 19th. Numerous flooding reports were received as 3-5 of rainfall occurred, resulting in 1 fatality in Northern Madison County.
ev: Water over Hwy 65 near Garth. Time estimated from radar.
Car submerged on Hwy 72 between Gurley and Paint Rock. Image seen on social media.
A 35 year old man drowned as a strong water current pulled him into a nearby drainage pipe along Bullard Road.
